title: Sydney Family Trip
subtitle: 27 November – 1 December 2026
tagline: Five easy days. 10+ family members. Based in Glebe.
foodNote: Mostly vegetarian. No beef or seafood. SEAFOOD ALLERGY: tell every kitchen. Ask about fish sauce, oyster sauce, shrimp paste, anchovies, stocks and shared cooking surfaces.

days.title: Harbour & First Views
days.summary: Arrival day. Rest first, then free famous views at sunset (around 7:45pm).

schedule.text: Land at Sydney Airport. Immigration, bags, pick up cars.
Drive to Glebe. Drop bags / check in if allowed.
Late lunch near Glebe, then rest.
Circular Quay → Opera House → Harbour Bridge views → The Rocks.
Dinner near the harbour, then home.

items.name: Hickson Road Reserve, The Rocks
items.text: Harbour Bridge framing. Stay for twilight if everyone feels up to it.

practical.heading: Parking & tickets
practical.text: Sydney Opera House Car Park, 2A Macquarie St (2.2m height limit). Prepaid evening rate from about A$40.75 per car. Looking around outside is FREE. Guided tour (~A$50) not advised after a flight.

food.name: Pancakes on the Rocks
food.text: Family-friendly. Savoury vegetarian dishes and pancakes.
food.map: Pancakes on the Rocks The Rocks Sydney

food.name: Chat Thai
food.text: Thai stir-fries and tofu curries. Check every sauce has no seafood.

food.name: The Spice Room
food.text: Paneer, dal, naan. Over budget: set banquet for groups of 6+.

days.title: Outlet Shopping & Hidden Gems
days.summary: DFO shopping, an optional short sight nearby, then Sydney-famous desserts.

schedule.text: Drive from Glebe in both cars.
DFO Homebush outlet shopping. Pick a meeting point first!
Late lunch at DFO (food court is easiest for mixed diets).
Optional: pick ONE sight below. Or go home and rest.
Dinner in Glebe or Newtown, then dessert if you like.

items.name: Brickpit Ring Walk
items.text: Round walkway high above an old quarry. 20–30 min. Great photos.
items.map: Brickpit Ring Walk Sydney Olympic Park

items.name: SS Ayrfield shipwreck
items.text: Rusty ship with trees growing out of it. 20–40 min. View from Parklands Circuit.

items.name: Bicentennial Park
items.text: Wetlands, mangrove boardwalk, tower views. 30–60 min. Easiest stroll.

practical.heading: Parking
practical.text: DFO: first 2 hours FREE, then about A$16 per car for 3½–4h. Shops normally open 10am–6pm Saturday. Olympic Park: register each car plate for 2 hours FREE, then A$5/hour.

treats.name: Yo-Chi
treats.text: Self-serve frozen yoghurt, pay by weight.

treats.name: Black Star Pastry
treats.text: Famous strawberry-watermelon cake (~A$13). Contains almonds. Newtown, open till 10pm Sat.

treats.name: Hakiki
treats.text: Turkish ice cream and baklava. Enmore Rd, Newtown.

days.title: Blue Mountains
days.summary: The big day: cable cars, rainforest and the Three Sisters.

schedule.text: Leave Glebe in both cars. About 2–2½ hours drive.
Scenic World: Skyway, Cableway, short rainforest boardwalk.
Late lunch in Katoomba (book ahead for 10+).
Echo Point: Three Sisters photos.
Drive back to Glebe. Dinner only if wanted.

highlights.heading: Don't miss

items.name: Scenic Skyway
items.text: Glass-floor cable car over the valley.

highlights.note: The Scenic Railway is very steep. Skip it unless each person wants to go.

practical.heading: Parking & tickets
practical.text: Book Scenic World tickets ahead for a ~12:30pm session (from A$64 per adult; Sunday may cost more). Scenic World, 1 Violet St: FREE parking (2m height limit). Echo Point: paid parking, check the machine.

food.name: Station Bar
food.text: BEST FIT. Wood-fired veg pizzas. Open 7 days.

food.name: Basil Nut
food.text: Asian fusion, vegan options. Sunday lunch until 3:30pm. Call ahead for 10+.

food.name: Pho Moi
food.text: Vietnamese noodles. Check the broth is vegetarian and Sunday hours.

food.name: 8Things
food.text: Global street food. Tight: closes about 3pm Sunday.

days.title: Bondi Beach & Ocean Views
days.summary: A slow beach day with ocean views and photos.

schedule.text: Leave Glebe. Allow extra time to park.
Bondi Beach walk, Pavilion and beach photos.
Bondi Icebergs viewpoint. Relax at a café. Fitter guests can walk part of the coast path.
Late lunch near the beach.
Relax, last photos, back to Glebe.
Optional dinner near home.

items.name: Icebergs viewpoint
items.text: Famous ocean pool with waves crashing in.

items.name: Bondi to Tamarama path (optional)
items.text: Cliffs and surf. Elders can stay at the cafés.

practical.heading: Parking
practical.text: Paid street bays on Queen Elizabeth Drive / Park Drive North, off Campbell Parade (7am–7pm). Check the price on the day. Accessible bays and ramps near the Pavilion. Beach and views are FREE.

food.name: Bondi Trattoria
food.text: TOP PICK. Monday risotto special A$27, veg pasta and pizza. Book for the group.

food.name: Bondi Pizza Gallery
food.text: Vegetarian pizzas. Check hours and seats for 10+.

food.name: Funky Pies
food.text: Vegan pies. Takeaway backup, not for a sit-down group.

days.title: On to Newcastle
days.summary: Check out. Sujay & Laura drive. Family takes the train. Meet in Newcastle.

schedule.text: Breakfast, pack, check out. Agree who carries which bags.
Sujay & Laura drive to Newcastle (about 2½–3 hours).
Family goes to Sydney Central Station with bags.
Take a CCN train to Newcastle (check times on the day).
Family arrives at Newcastle Interchange. Pickup as arranged.
Late lunch when you can. Bring vegetarian snacks for the train.

train.heading: Train steps for the family
steps: Go to Sydney Central Station. Arrive 20–30 min before the train.
Find the Central Coast & Newcastle Line (CCN) intercity train.
Tap on with an Opal card or contactless bank card. No booking needed.
Check the train sign says Newcastle (some trains stop earlier, at Gosford or Wyong). Ride about 2½–3 hours to Newcastle Interchange.
Tap off when you leave. Toilets, lifts and a taxi rank are there.

practical.heading: Car and bags
practical.text: Sujay & Laura take the car and the bulky bags. Family: choose a train carriage with room for luggage.
